body:
Jason consults at the executive level across immersive, interactive, experiential, entertainment, attraction, and live production — pushing innovation at the convergence of media, arts, and communication technologies.

Select Clients
Alphabet — Google ATAP, Jigsaw, Chrome, Creative Lab, Maps, YouTube
Meta — Reality Labs, Instagram, Facebook, Oculus
Sonos · Microsoft · General Motors · Spotify · SXSW
Nike · Netflix · Universal · Marvel
New York City Ballet · Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation
Robert Rauschenberg Foundation · Lancôme · Pepsi-Co
Equinox · Levi's · Van Alen Institute

Education & Formation
MS, Fiction & Entertainment — SCI-Arc
Directed a durational immersive transmedia cinematic experience via virtual production. Arriving imminently.
MPS, Interactive Telecommunications — NYU Tisch ITP
Thesis: a speculative critical design foundry producing luxury survival wares for those navigating technocratic urbanity and climate doom.
BA — Sarah Lawrence College
Dual concentration in Science, Technology & Society and Material Cultures of Sub-Saharan African cities. Co-founded the Agent Agitateur Video Collective. Stewarded Dominique Malaquais' Right2Fight Symposium. Helped bring Donna Haraway's treatises into active kinesis.

Community
Jason facilitates public innovation programs and experiential activations on behalf of the Queer Underground Hi-Speed Railways Continuum.
In 2018, he conceived and produced the Death by Audio Arcade Residency — a queer safe space fused with a DIY tech collective, culminating in the Dreamboxxx: nine original games anchored by a durational symposium.

Bildungsromans are key in the Chthulucene, after all.

At the center of his producorial endeavors live the three questions posed by Paul Gauguin's masterpiece:

Where Do We Come From? What Are We? Where Are We Going?

His response to these beseechments is this:

Our collaborations are how we get there.

He's just getting started. Mark thine words.
